summary: Two waves (5 tasks total): VH-JOURNAL-00x expands VeilHeart dawn reflection with minimal in-memory FJournalEntry generation/storage + BP hooks (builds on existing Process/Evaluate/DayNight path); PERSIST-00x adds UGloamsteadSaveGame + C++ save/load APIs + auto wiring at restoration success + dawn + inits + GameMode helpers for full dynamic ritual + tag + night + journal persistence via standard UE slot.
risk_notes: Load timing: InitializeFromPCGComponent (BP-called) vs. actor BeginPlay vs. DayNight init; duplicated slot create/populate/save code across Apply, dawn, and GameMode (vertical slice acceptable)

Current baseline VeilHeart auto-satisfaction path (RitualPlacementComponent->OnRestorationComplete binding) is non-functional (no delegate declared/broadcast in placement); journal acceptance relies on existing dawn call + explicit EvaluateRestorationAgainstWarnings in tests or post-confirm BP
